name: cs-learning-visualization
description: Make accurate CS learning visuals with readable SVG and selective interaction.

interface.longDescription: Design and verify educational SVGs for data structures, Java reference semantics, and backend protocols. Default to static diagrams; add interactions only when they teach a meaningful state change.
capabilities: Review semantic accuracy and reader accessibility
defaultPrompt: Heap 트리·배열, Java Pass-by-Value, TCP Sliding Window를 정확한 교재형 SVG로 시각화하고 검토해줘.
